notes: Two program-list pages, both The Ohio State University (Fisher): the Operations Management PhD alumni table (1970-2016, names with graduation year, initial placement and current institution; 2019 capture) is the valuable one; the school-wide PhD alumni page carries only featured profiles with current positions, three of them Management Sciences (Rachna Shah 2002, Gopesh Anand 2006, Stephanie Eckerd 2011), and should not be read as a complete list. The Texas A&M Mays placement page (2007-2012) names hiring institutions per year but no graduates or departments, so it was marked not-a-list; it could still corroborate employers once graduates are known from other sources. The Stevens wireless-lab dissertation list is a real dissertation list but belongs to electrical engineering, not Howe School or systems engineering. All institutions kept as given by host. Several McCombs URLs are duplicate captures of the same page.
